settings.integration.label: Integration declaration
settings.integration.why: The `integration` object of the repository's `daoris.gates.json`: the generated files its integration writes, the rules it runs and the scratch its clean-up clears. It is used only as you accept it, by its blob, apart from the gates of the landed route; a repository's own file never grants itself.
settings.integration.accepted: Accepted. Its generated files, line rules and scratch are used as you accepted them, at blob {{blob}} on {{branch}}'s tip {{commit}}.
settings.integration.acceptedNone: Accepted as none: {{branch}}'s tip {{commit}} declares no integration, and nothing is used until one lands and you accept it.
settings.integration.changed: The declaration changed since you accepted it: none of it is used until you accept it again.
settings.integration.unaccepted: The declaration is not accepted yet: none of it is used until you accept it.
settings.integration.unread: Where the integration declaration stands could not be read here.
